public_body: Medfield Permanent Building And Planning Committee
overall: The AG found the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to timely approve all 2018 meeting minutes and by failing to respond to a minutes request within 10 days; resolved by informal action with orders.

allegations.summary: The Committee allegedly failed to timely approve minutes for all of its 2018 meetings.
allegations.key_passage: As the Committee failed to approve meeting minutes for more than a year, beginning in late 2017, we find that the Committee failed to approve meeting minutes in a timely manner for all meetings which took place in 2018.

allegations.summary: The Committee allegedly failed to respond within 10 days to a February 24 request for its 2018 meeting minutes.
allegations.key_passage: As the Committee did not respond to Ms. Potts’ February 24 request for minutes within 10 calendar days, we find that the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
Within 30 days of receipt of the determination, approve minutes for all 2018 meetings, if not already done.
Within 35 days of receipt of the determination, send copies of the approved 2018 minutes to the complainant, if not already done.
remedy_passage: We order the Committee’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and caution the Committee that a determination by our office of a similar violation in the future may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Open Meeting Law.
